company_notes: Overview: mid-market retail marketplace (~12M SKUs live; 25M including variants). Focus: replace keyword search + heuristics with semantic embeddings + reranking to improve CTR and AOV.

Primary ask: accurate rerank after semantic retrieval so top-3 results convert better, while keeping cost per query < $0.001 (target) at baseline; tolerate up to 2x on peak events but want plan for BF/Cyber weekend.
Latency SLOs: 95th < 150ms for search queries (end-to-end), p50 < 50ms. Currently 95th ~420ms with current in-house retrieval+heuristic rerank under load.
Indexing scale: initial catalog snapshot 12M objects; plan daily incremental ingestion (avg 150k adds/changes per day). Want ability to re-embed entire catalog quarterly for model updates.
Traffic profile: steady 1.2k QPS daytime, spikes to 80k QPS during promo events. Concerned about cost during 72-hour BF peak window.

Model preferences: open checkpoints preferred (cost), but willing to evaluate Redwood-verified quantized variants. Want fallback chain: full-precision reranker -> quantized reranker -> heuristic fallback.
Routing needs: geo-aware routing (NA primary), canary deploys for new reranker weights, instant rollback on quality degradation.
Security/compliance: must live inside VPC with customer-managed KMS, audit logs retained 365d, SSO via SAML, data residency: store embeddings and index shards in us-east-1 only.

POC scope (agreed 2025-09-18 call): ingest 10M product vectors, run 1M sample queries (mix of nav, search, and voice) with rerank latency breakdown and token-level cost report. Deliver: perf dashboard + cost projection for BF peak.

Recent activity: 2025-09-12 kickoff intro (Jordan P.); 2025-09-18 scoping call (ff_2025-09-18_983); 2025-09-24 infra deep-dive (security team + Priya N.); 2025-09-30 demo of Redwood Optimize suggestions (ff_2025-09-30_1042).
Quotes from PO: 'We need reliable unit economics — we cannot let search costs spiral on holiday spikes.' Wants explicit cost per query at 95th and worst-case burst.

Infra notes: current stack: Postgres + S3 for product master, Kafka event stream for updates, retrieval service uses Elastic for inverted indices. Plan: keep canonical store; add embedding index service (annoy/hnsw) managed or hosted.
Engineering constraints: limited SRE time for custom orchestration, prefer Redwood-managed autoscaling for embeddings serving; need runbook for degraded fallback.
Legal/security blockers: Seastone infosec requested Redwood SOC2 report + SAML integration checklist; legal reviewing DPA with strict residency clause.

Next steps (short): 1) Redwood to deliver POC runbook + cost estimate by 2025-10-05. 2) Seastone to provide sample 10M export + traffic replay by 2025-10-07. 3) Schedule kickoff for infra (VPC peering) week of 2025-10-13.
Internal notes (AE): budget signaled but exec wants 2 vendor pricing comps before procurement; call out Optimize ROI numbers for embeddings caching and batching to win.
Acceptance criteria for POC: end-to-end 95th latency < 150ms for at least 95% of queries in test; rerank recall@10 improved vs baseline by +12% and cost per query within target band.
Potential upsell: Dedicated pool for predictable throughput + Premium support during BF; optional Private deployment for EU expansion in 2026.
